I am applying for the Staff Data Engineer role. For the last three years I have
owned ingestion and transformation for a telemetry platform handling 8B+ events
a week, and the work you describe on tenant-level isolation is the problem I
spent most of last year on.

The posting asks for someone who can make orchestration self-service. I built a
CLI that generates workflow definitions from a tenant profile, which removed
hand-editing of job specs and let the team size clusters per tenant without
touching the scheduler. It is the change I would want to make first.

You also mention consolidating legacy pipelines. I led a migration of 1,200+ of
them into a source-controlled monorepo, adding CI and schema validation as we
went. The hard part was not the move; it was persuading people that a pipeline
without a test is a pipeline nobody can change.

I would welcome the chance to talk about what the first six months would look
like.
